Cloud thinking: minimal reduces latency, falling back within the original deadline when explicitly unsupported. provider-default uses the service default. Both preserve all quality checks.

Python used for tests. Check and Prepare Python Test Environment finds an existing environment with dependencies and saves its path. AST, qualification, Trace, coverage and mutation share this setting. Empty uses the project/workspace .venv, then PATH python.

Without requirements, prefer these import-to-pip mappings, e.g. PIL → Pillow. Unmapped imports become same-name candidates for confirmed installation and recheck. Edit and save mappings in the installation list.

Pre-import test fixtures mock external operations during initialization of specified source files without modifying them. Shared by preflight, Trace, tests and built-in mutation. file is relative to the target project. Use test data only; never enter credentials.

Map same-directory ini filenames to test content for ConfigParser.read.
External initialization functions mocked to return None at module top level in this file. Actual blocked calls can suggest fixtures for preview and confirmation.
Suggested entry-point names bound to source lines. Mock only top-level calls on these lines; preserve other calls.
Generated source version for initialization entry points. Source changes require a new preview and confirmation; old line bindings must not be reused.
